caption: A large cymbal is struck, and the cymbal wobbles on its stand and its edge blurs before it steadies.

sa.check: A large cymbal on a stand.
The cymbal wobbles on its stand and its edge blurs.
The cymbal stays seated on its stand through the wobble.
The order is strike, wobble, steady.

pc.expect: The cymbal hangs still on its stand until the stick reaches it; the wobble and the edge blur begin at the strike and only then.
pc.fail: The cymbal is already rocking or blurred before the stick arrives; or wobbles while the stick is well away; or is hit and stays rigidly still; or steadies and starts wobbling again with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The wobble is largest right after the strike and shrinks steadily; the edge blur narrows until the rim is sharp and still.
pc.fail: The wobble grows after the strike with no second hit; or holds the same size for the whole clip; or the cymbal stops dead from a large wobble.

pc.expect: The cymbal stays a rigid metal disc that tilts and rocks as a whole about the stand's tip.
pc.fail: The cymbal folds or creases; or the stick sinks into the metal; or a dent appears where the stick lands and stays; or the rim curls.

pc.expect: The cymbal wobbles about the stand's tip, staying centred on it and tilting one way then the other; the stand stays put.
pc.fail: The cymbal slides off the stand's tip; or spins round and round like a plate; or lifts clear of the stand and hangs in the air; or the stand's base slides across the floor.

pc.expect: One cymbal, one stand and one stick; the stick passes through nothing and the cymbal stays one disc.
pc.fail: The stick passes through the cymbal; or the cymbal splits or a second cymbal appears; or the stand vanishes; or the cymbal changes into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cymbal's finish and lathing, the stand's colour and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The cymbal changes colour or finish; or the stand's height changes between frames; or the background changes.
